# Retrieve evidence before drafting — applied workshop

You support an operations analysis team. Rank source snippets by token overlap and identify an unsupported query.

## Concept setup · 10 minutes
Retrieval narrows available evidence. Lexical matching is a transparent baseline but misses paraphrases. Similarity does not establish support; inspect source identifiers and unanswered cases.

## Implementation · 20 minutes
Rank three supplied snippets against 'approval required' by token overlap, then by ID for ties. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

## Task · 20 minutes
Rank source snippets by token overlap and identify an unsupported query. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

## Research and discussion · 15 minutes
Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

## Wrap-up · 5 minutes
Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

## Submission
Draft cohort policy: 2–3-page APA-style paper with relevant code, output screenshots and citations. Word/PDF upload and Sunday 11:59 PM deadline need a scheduled cohort; no live deadline is set.

## Integrity
AI coaching on concepts and ungraded practice is allowed with disclosure. Graded reasoning must be your own.
